authority: reviewer 2026-09-19: make this a permanent visualization contract for every model lineage, not an optional afterthought. The first two artifacts occur before interpretation or tuning; the final two before declaring the lineage complete.
rationale: WS-PROP-1 showed a scalar gate can be blind to timing structure while the underlying trajectories visibly diverge. Its rate-count observable returned exactly 0.000000 at V1_1, the directly stimulated area, in a regime where the two-window spike count per E cell is conserved at exactly 21.000000. The trajectories were not identical: 12 V1_1 groups differed. A human looking at a raster would have seen in one glance both that the model was globally periodic and that the stimulus moved timing rather than count. Human-readable dynamics are therefore required early, not at the end.
invariant_chain: construct -> HSPICE schematic -> initial 1 s raster -> scientific work -> final raster -> atlas

V0.name: construction
V0.purpose: verify what circuit was actually constructed
required_content: x on the far left and y on the far right
E, PV, SST and VIP populations where present
connection authority g, or realized w where relevant
V0.note: HSPICE/PSpice-style block schematic. This is the construction receipt humans inspect.

V1.name: initial state
V1.purpose: see the untreated native dynamical regime before any scientific modification
V1.timing: first 1000 ms diagnostic, before interpretation or tuning
required_content: unit rows ordered area -> layer -> cell type
the ordering and visual conventions reused verbatim by V2
V1.note: the visual baseline. Do not wait until the experiment is finished to discover the starting model is globally periodic, silent, saturated or otherwise unexpected.

V2.name: final state
V2.purpose: direct before and after comparison against V1
required_content: the same ordering and visual conventions as V1
the same duration and window as V1 wherever possible

V3.name: final inspection
V3.purpose: deep human inspection of dynamics, state, connectivity and plasticity
required_content: field or lfp_proxy ONLY when appropriately qualified

lineage_field_shape: an object with keys V0, V1, V2, V3, each a repository path that resolves at the lineage record's own commit
report_requirement: the acceptance report of every lineage must list all four artifact paths

enforcement.rule: every executed lineage record not listed in grandfathered must carry the lineage_field with all four stages, and each path must resolve at the record's own commit
enforcement.grandfathered_reason: the contract is additive and is not applied retroactively. Sealed artifacts never change, and no earlier lineage is reopened to satisfy a rule written after it ran.

exemption.rule: a lineage that constructs no model and runs no simulation may set visualization to the string NOT_A_MODEL_LINEAGE with a reason, and the validator accepts it.
exemption.note: a pure harness-repair lineage is the intended case. It is an exemption from the artifacts, never from declaring why.
